input.free_text_description: The system operates in the microservices infrastructure, file management domain. It serves API Consumer, Customer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include aggregation, config client, movie.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage application configuration centrally, so that all services pick up the latest settings without redeployment.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents as needed.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage aggregation operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage config client operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
